changelog: Fixed Webmail message list preview duplicating message body text on multipart/alternative emails
Enhanced Postfix virtual alias mapping to preserve local mailbox delivery alongside forwarders
Fixed SMTP mail server delivery failure caused by Postfix rejecting numeric IP hostnames
Added strict FQDN hostname validation and real-time warnings preventing numeric IP configurations
Added automatic SQLite database driver detection and configuration for Postfix and Dovecot
Included postfix-sqlite, dovecot-sqlite, and sqlite3 in mail stack installation and base packages
